title: oven-grilled chinese tofu bao
description: a deliciously herbal and juicy chinese dish featuring grilled tofu and blueberries, perfect for a date night. this vegan-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm or extra-firm tofu works best for this recipe

ingredients.name: blueberries
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen blueberries can be used

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried ginger can be used

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: minced garlic adds a nice depth of flavor

ingredients.name: hoisin sauce
ingredients.notes: use a vegan version or make your own

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: use a low-sodium version or tamari

ingredients.name: sesame oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality sesame oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free version or substitute with apple cider vinegar

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free version or substitute with tapioca starch

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free version or substitute with almond flour

ingredients.name: warm water
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free version or substitute with non-dairy milk

instructions: preheat the oven to 400f (200c) and prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper.
cut the tofu into small cubes and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
drizzle the sesame oil over the tofu and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
bake the tofu in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
while the tofu is baking, prepare the sauce by whisking together the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and cornstarch in a small bowl.
once the tofu is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
place the buns on a baking sheet and warm them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
assemble the bao by placing a few pieces of the baked tofu onto each bun, followed by a spoonful of the sauce and some fresh blueberries.
to make the sauce, heat a small saucepan over medium heat and whisk together the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened and reduced slightly.
remove from heat and stir in the sesame oil and scallions.
